name: checkpoint
title: Checkpoint
description: **Durable resume point** for long-running / resumable flows. A **top-level-only** marker (like `await`): the first time a run reaches it, the position is recorded durably; a later re-run of the *same* flow in the *same* session fast-forwards past the already-completed prefix (its symbols are still durably bound and its side effects are not repeated) and continues from here. `label` is a human-readable name for the phase it closes. Pairs with `once` for finer-grained idempotency; a no-op when no durable store is wired. Requires a non-empty literal label.
